data.name: Farhal
data.gender_notes: Farhal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is joyful and happy. The name Farhal carries the meaning “Happy, joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Farhal usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the joy and happiness that comes from within and being content with oneself
data.etymology: Farhal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farhal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فرحل
in_arabic.meaning: فرح و مسرت کا باعث بننے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرحل نام کا معنی ہے خوشحالی اور مسرت کا سبب بننے والا۔ یہ نام فرح کے معنی میں ہے جو قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے۔ فرح کا مطلب ہے خوش ہونا، مسرت حاصل کرنا، اور আনੰਦ کا अनुभव کرنا۔ اسلامی روایات میں فرح اللہ کے فضل اور کرم کا اشارہ ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فرحال
in_urdu.meaning: فرح و خوشی کا باعث بننے والا، مسرت کا سبب
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرحال نام عربی زبان کے لفظ 'فرح' سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور مسرت۔ یہ نام ان بچوں کے لئے دیا جاتا ہے جو والدین کے لئے خوشحالی اور आनੰਦ کا ذریعہ بنتے ہیں۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، فرح اللہ کی رحمت اور فضل کی علامت ہے، اور یہ نام بچے کی زندگی میں مثبت 에너جی اور خوشحالی کی دعا کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फरहल
in_hindi.meaning: खुशियों का कारण बनने वाला, सुखद
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरहल नाम का अर्थ है खुशी और सुख का कारण बनने वाला। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'फराह' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है खुशी और आनंद। इस्लामी परंपरा में, फराह अल्लाह की कृपा और अनुग्रह का प्रतीक है। यह नाम बच्चे के लिए सकारात्मक ऊर्जा और खुशहाली की कामना के रूप में दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فرحل
in_pashto.meaning: د خوښۍ سبب ګرځیدونکی، خوشحال کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرحل نوم د خوښۍ او خوشحالي سبب ګرځیدونکی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د کلمې 'فرح' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د خوښۍ او خوشحالي معنی لري. په اسلامي کلتور کې، فرح د الله تعالی د رحمت او فضل نښه ده، او دا نوم د ماشوم د ژوند لپاره د مثبتی انرژی او خوشحالي دعا په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Farhal
in_english.meaning: Bringer of joy, happiness, and delight
in_english.long_meaning: The name Farhal is derived from the Arabic root 'F-R-Ḥ', which means to rejoice, be glad, or feel happy. In Islamic tradition, Farḥ (فرح) refers to divine joy, happiness, and bliss. The name Farhal signifies a person who brings happiness, joy, and delight to others. It is often given to children in the hope that they will spread positivity, happiness, and cheerfulness throughout their lives.

data.cultural_impact: The name Farhal can be seen as a reminder of the importance of joy and happiness in one's life. In Islamic culture, happiness and contentment are highly valued. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged his followers to seek happiness and to promote happiness for others. The name Farhal can be an inspiration for individuals to find joy in their daily lives and to spread happiness to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic faith teaches that true happiness and contentment come from within, through a strong connection with God. The name Farhal can also be seen as a reminder of the spiritual joy and happiness that come from living in accordance with God's will and being grateful for His blessings. The name Farhal can motivate individuals to strive for spiritual growth and to nurture their relationship with God, which can lead to a greater sense of inner peace and happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Happy, joyful" symbolizes A person who is joyful and happy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Farhal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of happy, joyful.
